## Formal {.unnumbered}

$$
    N_{t+1} = b N_t - d N_t
$${#eq-birth-death-discrete}

## Examples {.unnumbered}

```{r}
#| code-fold: false
#| fig-cap: "Birth-death discrete trajectories for three different r values"
#| label: fig-birth-death-discrete-sim

# Function to simulate birth-death discrete trajectories
simulate_bd_discrete <- function(N0, r, time_steps, n_trajectories = 100) {
  # N0: initial population size
  # r: net growth rate (b - d)
  # time_steps: number of time steps to simulate
  # n_trajectories: number of trajectories to simulate

  trajectories <- matrix(NA, nrow = time_steps + 1, ncol = n_trajectories)
  trajectories[1, ] <- N0

  for (t in 1:time_steps) {
    trajectories[t + 1, ] <- trajectories[t, ] * (1 + r)
  }

  return(trajectories)
}

# Parameters
N0 <- 10  # Initial population
time_steps <- 20

# Example 1: Default r (positive, moderate growth)
r_default <- 0.05
traj_default <- simulate_bd_discrete(N0, r_default, time_steps, n_trajectories = 100)

# Example 2: Negative r (decline)
r_negative <- -0.05
traj_negative <- simulate_bd_discrete(N0, r_negative, time_steps, n_trajectories = 100)

# Example 3: Higher r (strong growth)
r_higher <- 0.1
traj_higher <- simulate_bd_discrete(N0, r_higher, time_steps, n_trajectories = 100)

# Combine all trajectories for plotting
time <- 0:time_steps
y_max <- max(c(traj_default, traj_negative, traj_higher), na.rm = TRUE)

# Single plot with all three scenarios
plot(NA, xlim = c(0, time_steps), ylim = c(0, y_max),
     xlab = "Time", ylab = "Population size (N)",
     main = "Birth-death discrete: effect of r")

# Plot trajectories for each r value with different colors
for (i in 1:ncol(traj_default)) {
  points(time, traj_default[, i], col = rgb(0, 0, 1, 0.2), pch = 16, cex = 0.6)
}
for (i in 1:ncol(traj_negative)) {
  points(time, traj_negative[, i], col = rgb(1, 0, 0, 0.2), pch = 16, cex = 0.6)
}
for (i in 1:ncol(traj_higher)) {
  points(time, traj_higher[, i], col = rgb(0, 0.7, 0, 0.2), pch = 16, cex = 0.6)
}

# Add legend
legend("topright",
       legend = c(paste0("r = ", r_default),
                  paste0("r = ", r_negative),
                  paste0("r = ", r_higher)),
       col = c(rgb(0, 0, 1, 0.8), rgb(1, 0, 0, 0.8), rgb(0, 0.7, 0, 0.8)),
       pch = 16, cex = 0.9)
```
